# Salinas LULAC Council #2055

> Salinas LULAC Council #2055 is the Salinas, California council of the League of United Latin American Citizens (LULAC). Founded in 1973, the council runs supportive services, community programs, and leadership development for the Hispanic community of Salinas and the Salinas Valley. It is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit; donations are tax-deductible. LULAC Youth Council #2087 is the council's youth chapter.

Contact: P.O. Box 1396, Salinas, CA 93902. Phone 831-206-9089. Email barrerasr86@yahoo.com. President: Christopher Barrera.

## Pages

- [Home](https://lulacsalinas2055.org/): council overview, meetings, recent activity, what we work on
- [Officers](https://lulacsalinas2055.org/officers.html): current council officers and roles
- [Issues](https://lulacsalinas2055.org/issues.html): the six areas LULAC organizes around: economic advancement, education, political engagement, housing, health, civil rights
- [Politics](https://lulacsalinas2055.org/politics.html): links to Salinas and Monterey County elected officials
- [Sponsors and Donors](https://lulacsalinas2055.org/sponsors-donors.html): sponsor and silent-auction donor recognition
- [Contact](https://lulacsalinas2055.org/contact.html): phone, email, membership, donations, and the Human Rights Complaint Form (PDF)
- [Youth Council #2087](https://lulacsalinas2055.org/youth.html): LULAC Salinas Youth Council
- [Black and White Ball 2023](https://lulacsalinas2055.org/black-white-ball-2023.html): 50th anniversary gala, October 21, 2023, Hartnell College
- [Photos](https://lulacsalinas2055.org/photos.html): council photo gallery
- [Videos](https://lulacsalinas2055.org/videos.html): History of LULAC video
- [Help and Referrals](https://lulacsalinas2055.org/help.html): legal aid, consumer protection, civil rights, social services, and housing agencies serving Monterey County
- [Coronavirus Response](https://lulacsalinas2055.org/coronavirus-resources.html): photo record of the council's food distribution and community response, 2020 to 2021

## About LULAC

- [LULAC National](https://lulac.org/): the League of United Latin American Citizens, founded 1929, the largest and oldest Hispanic civil rights organization in the United States
